name: North Star

contribution_model.verified_in_origin: An inspected execution record supports bounded origin behavior; applicability remains a hypothesis.
contribution_model.adapted: A real implementation exists in a new context, beyond planning.
contribution_model.integrated_into_north_star: A genuine North Star consumer uses the capability with destination verification.
contribution_model.externally_validated: Relevant destination behavior/experience has independent evaluation; specify what and by whom.

evidence_boundary: One local executable character consumer exists. NS-C03 combat, NS-C04 bounded consequential dialogue and NS-C07 sound methods are adapted into the prototype, not shared-kernel imports or production MMORPG integration. Eleven other states retain origin/candidate scope. Native/render/mixer checks and agent review are not independent human validation; final engine remains undecided.

capabilities.title: Resource transactions and economy
capabilities.scope: C# local-match resource budgets, legal actions, replay and any-seat shared-device presentation.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Research whether resource transactions and economy serves a bounded North Star experiment; no consumer or reusable contract exists yet.
capabilities.limits: Four-seat deterministic match rules, not shared-world ownership, concurrent spending, general balance or a market economy.
capabilities.next_validation: Specify resource ownership and costs, then test one authoritative command contract under retries and simultaneous requests.

capabilities.title: RPG domain and durable session recovery
capabilities.scope: Pure C# turn-based rescue domain, supply consequences, replay-validated saves and native Linux delivery.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Research whether rpg domain and durable session recovery serves a bounded North Star experiment; no consumer or reusable contract exists yet.
capabilities.limits: New Cinderwatch implementation; not recovered RGSS code. Local session saves do not establish account persistence or server trust.
capabilities.next_validation: Test a separately owned inventory/progression slice and crash recovery without trusting client-written state.

capabilities.title: Movement and action combat feedback
capabilities.scope: Native physics, committed locked contact, paid close-sweep guard, phase hazards, animation and scripted engine checks.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: The local crossing demonstrates distinct finite-resource protection/redirection paths; perceived character identity and broader combat applicability remain hypotheses requiring player observation.
capabilities.limits: Single-player desktop timing; not lag compensation, networked combat, human balance or multiplayer prediction.
capabilities.next_validation: Observe actual unassisted players explaining direction, interception, feint and reachable counters before judging identity, fairness or balance.
capabilities.destination_scope: One local courier encounter adapts P06 contact/commitment methodology into finite-resource frontal protection versus locked-line redirection, not shared-code import. Real-model rehearsal freezes causal review and starts a clean crossing. Guardian selects sustained Steady or 60-300ms Riposte with a confirmed 1.6s opening. Three eligible close counters stop this sentinel and double courier pace; gate/survival still own success and pure protection remains complete. Optional medicine needs actual timed recovery and a separate moving handoff while threats continue. Earned, voluntarily worn cosmetic marks and recoverable twelve-action remaps use editable device-local profiles. Independent session-only guard/interaction toggles preserve costs, timing and commitment; interruption/completion disarm intentions. Read-only original actor gestures expose actual events. This is bounded destination adaptation/production, not P10 dialogue/P07 atlas import, NS-C13 promotion, human identity/accessibility/balance validation, account/MMO integration or final class/canon approval. A reversible native preparation workshop makes one of two visibly worn health/mobility fittings for either approach; no origin economy import, profession progression, new capability promotion or persistent power. An optional committed courier detour adds real travel distance and partial geometric bolt interception with distinct ownership; no floor immunity, free opening, origin import or final geography approval. Optional continuation carries actual arrival health/energy and fitting into a stationary-winch, two-catch and alive-exit objective; existing paid defenses/counters serve both work-first and shutdown-first routes. That continuation introduced no additional capability state, canon or human validation. Free appearance has independent skin, hair and cloth choices, shared actual drawing/action previews and explicit draft/apply/discard; default art and actual mechanics remain. Explicit apply now retains bounded skin/hair/dye indices through the recoverable local cosmetic profile; legacy migration and actual process reentry are executed. No recognition, full creator, account or persistent RPG power claim.

capabilities.title: Dialogue, quests and consequential narrative
capabilities.scope: Actual Python rescue rules and browser night/morning/noon consequences; dialogue decisions affect local resources and voluntary help.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: An optional factual courier conversation now carries one exclusive aid choice into the real return goal; perceived narrative significance and character identity still require player observation.
capabilities.limits: Original local dialogue and a session-only prepared checkpoint; no P10 fiction/code import, general narrative kernel, reputation, persistent social simulation or independent player validation.
capabilities.next_validation: Observe unassisted players recalling the actual crossing facts and explaining the mutually exclusive aid consequences before judging comprehension, significance or preference.
capabilities.destination_scope: New native code adapts the inspected P10 precondition-before-mutation and fact-owned-response method. Actual escort facts feed an optional original courier conversation; deliberate confirmation allocates a single strip to capped prepared health or winch integrity, or leaves it with the courier. Only confirmed aid reaches the actual next objective; reopening/retry cannot accumulate benefits. Direct continuation and no-aid mechanics remain. No origin implementation/fiction, emotion model or persistent work-shift campaign is imported; this is bounded destination adaptation, not production integration or independent human validation.

capabilities.title: Literary editing and localization
capabilities.scope: Complete separate PT/EN adaptation, paired reader-format production and implementing-translator continuity review.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Research whether literary editing and localization serves a bounded North Star experiment; no consumer or reusable contract exists yet.
capabilities.limits: Attached historical manuscripts/policy remain unreadable; old v0.4.48 inspection is a report. Format checks are not author canon approval or independent literary validation.
capabilities.next_validation: Recover and audit literary sources, then have independent readers evaluate agency, voice, causal continuity and localization before lore selection.

capabilities.title: Visual production, animation and interface readability
capabilities.scope: Original generated portrait/atlas production with provenance, alpha-bound catalogs and actual native consumers.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Research whether visual production, animation and interface readability serves a bounded North Star experiment; no consumer or reusable contract exists yet.
capabilities.limits: Static portraits/four-keyframe poses; no full production pipeline, independent artist approval, exclusive rights or commercial clearance.
capabilities.next_validation: Choose a consuming scene and acceptance frames; test identity, movement readability, rights and asset import in that destination.

capabilities.title: Rhythm timing and adaptive sound
capabilities.scope: Real timing/calibration/rehearsal workflow, rendered original audio, original-pitch tempo derivatives and native phase-responsive mixing.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Event-driven warning and role-response cues now execute in the local destination; recognition, mix comfort and physical timing remain hypotheses.
capabilities.limits: Scripted signal/clock samples and bounded mixer execution, not physical listening, universal timbre/latency, player learning or multiplayer synchronization.
capabilities.next_validation: Evaluate warning/response recognition and mix comfort with relevant people and physical devices; measure end-to-end latency before claims about real output timing.
capabilities.destination_scope: New deterministic procedural mono cues adapt the P08/P06 semantic-event, bounded-voice and mute/pause method in the actual crossing and rehearsal. Source/PCK AudioServer capture verifies warnings and consequences, including actual block/draw, counter/damage and terminal outcomes. No old cue/music file or sound kernel is imported. Rhythm calibration, tempo derivatives and MMO/spatial mixing are not transferred. The actual threat voice also stops on sentinel shutdown while accepted counter audio remains; no new PCM or spatial claim.

capabilities.title: Messaging, durable records and recovery
capabilities.scope: Trusted local rooms with SQLite persistence, idempotent send retry, revision/source context, backups and portable read-only copies.
capabilities.applicability_hypothesis: Research whether messaging, durable records and recovery serves a bounded North Star experiment; no consumer or reusable contract exists yet.
capabilities.limits: Chosen labels are not authenticated identities. Chat receipts/SQLite schemas are not authoritative world commands, MMORPG backend, moderation or production-load evidence.
capabilities.next_validation: Define actor identity, command authorization and conflict semantics; test domain-specific persistence/recovery separately from chat.
